aggressive_definition_excerpt: The hypothesis that dietary factors might be more strongly related to advanced prostate tumours could not be confirmed in our study.
study_design: Prospective case-cohort analysis within the Netherlands Cohort Study
cohort_total_n_excerpt: At baseline in 1986, 58,279 men aged 55-69 years completed a self-administered 150-item food frequency questionnaire and a questionnaire on other risk factors for cancer.
reason: The prospective study analyzes overall prostate cancer incidence and explicitly reports an analysis of advanced prostate tumours. The abstract does not provide the advanced-case count or numeric advanced-disease estimates.
